title: Count the words
prompt: Given an array of words, return a dictionary where each word is a key and its value is how many times it appeared. ["a", "b", "a"] gives {"a": 2, "b": 1}.
hints: For each word, start its count at 0 the first time you meet it.

docs.name: {"key": value}
docs.what: Makes a dictionary: named slots you read and write with data["key"].

docs.name: key in data
docs.what: true if the dictionary has that key.
